title: Fix FIDO2 key generation on macOS and Linux install hints

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Two fixes: (1) Use Homebrew ssh-keygen binary for FIDO2 instead of searching for libsk-libfido2.dylib which doesn't exist in modern openssh. (2) Change Linux gitleaks install hint from brew to apt/dnf.

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Both fixes already applied in working tree. Shellcheck clean, 92/92 tests pass.
